intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded year fees and recent placements from our database and official sites opened in {{year}}.

Jagran Lakecity University vs Rabindranath Tagore University is a private-university BBA comparison in Bhopal. The recorded year fees differ sharply, so check the official notices before you treat the lower figure as a full-cost bargain.

sections.heading: Jagran Lakecity University vs Rabindranath Tagore University for BBA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Jagran Lakecity University if you want a wider listed BBA set, with recorded year figures from ₹90,000 to ₹1.45 lakh, and a 2022 advertising-and-PR record of ₹6 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest.
Choose Rabindranath Tagore University if you want the recorded year tuition of ₹20,000 and the 2023 BBA record of ₹4 lakh average and ₹7 lakh highest, after you confirm the official fee notice.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Jagran Lakecity University we hold several year figures, including ₹90,000 tuition for BBA Finance, ₹1 lakh totals or tuition on some rows, and ₹1.45 lakh tuition on business analytics, marketing and HR. These are year amounts, not a confirmed three-year official total.

For Rabindranath Tagore University we hold ₹20,000 as tuition for one year across the listed BBA rows. That is also a year figure, not a confirmed three-year official total, and we have not multiplied it.
Confirm the current notices on jlu.edu.in and rntu.ac.in before you budget. The fee gap is large enough to double-check what is included.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Jagran Lakecity University has a 2022 BBA Advertising and PR row of ₹6 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest. Rabindranath Tagore University has a 2023 BBA row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹7 lakh highest.
These are historical records for those programmes, not a promise for every BBA stream. Ask both placement cells for a later official report if you need 2025 figures.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each university's official undergraduate admissions process.
Jagran Lakecity University has India Today ranks of 117 in 2024 and 130 in 2023 on our records. Rabindranath Tagore University has no rank row here. These are not NIRF ranks.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are private universities in Bhopal, so a local student can visit them without leaving the city.
Jagran Lakecity lists many named BBA and BMS titles. Rabindranath Tagore University lists a shorter BBA set, including IT and financial markets. Match the stream, not only the city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Jagran Lakecity University if the wider programme list, the 2022 recorded average of ₹6 lakh, and the higher year fees are acceptable.
Pick Rabindranath Tagore University if the recorded ₹20,000 year tuition and the 2023 average of ₹4 lakh fit your plan, after official confirmation.
Compare the exact BBA stream, because the two universities do not list the same specialisations.
